body.arabic: ‏قَالَ يَنُوحُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَلِحٍۢ ۖ فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَهِلِينَ ‎
body.asad: [God] answered: "O Noah, behold, he was not of thy family, for, verily, he was unrighteous in his conduct. [68] And thou shalt not ask of Me anything whereof thou canst not have any knowledge: [69] thus, behold, do I admonish thee lest thou become one of those who are unaware [of what is right]." [70]
body.phonetic: Qala ya noohu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu AAamalun ghayru salihin fala tasalni ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun innee aAAithuka an takoona mina aljahileena
body.pickthall: He said: "O Nuh (Noah)! Surely, he is not of your family; verily, his work is unrighteous, so ask not of Me that of which you have no knowledge! I admonish you, lest you be one of the ignorants."
body.text_en: He said: "O Nuh (Noah)! Surely, he is not of your family; verily, his work is unrighteous, so ask not of Me that of which you have no knowledge! I admonish you, lest you be one of the ignorants."
body.urdu: فرمایا اے نوح وہ تیرے گھر والو ں میں سے نہیں ہے کیوں کہ اس کے عمل اچھے نہیں ہیں سو مجھ سے مت پوچھ جس کا تجھے علم نہیں میں تمہیں نصیحت کرتا ہوں کہ کہیں جاہلوں میں نہ ہو جاؤ

body.text_en: And there is no living creature on earth whose sustenance is not the responsibility of Allah.

body.arabic: ‏ رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَوَتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْآخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّلِحِينَ ‎
body.asad: "O my Sustainer! Thou hast indeed bestowed upon me something of power, [101] and hast imparted unto me some knowledge of the inner meaning of happenings. [102] Originator of the heavens and the earth! Thou art near unto me in this world and in the life to come: let me die as one who has surrendered himself unto Thee, and make me one with the righteous!"
body.phonetic: Rabbi qad ataytanee mina almulki waAAallamtanee min taweeli alahadeethi fatira alssamawati waalardi anta waliyyee fee alddunya waalakhirati tawaffanee musliman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena
body.pickthall: "My Lord! You have indeed bestowed on me of the sovereignty, and taught me the interpretation of dreams; The (only) Creator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Walî (Protector, Helper, Supporter, Guardian, etc.) in this world and in the Hereafter, cause me to die as a Muslim (the one submitting to Your Will), and join me with the righteous."
body.text_en: "My Lord! You have indeed bestowed on me of the sovereignty, and taught me the interpretation of dreams; The (only) Creator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Walî (Protector, Helper, Supporter, Guardian, etc.) in this world and in the Hereafter, cause me to die as a Muslim (the one submitting to Your Will), and join me with the righteous."
body.urdu: اے میرے رب تو نے مجھےکچھ حکومت دی ہے اور مجھے خوابوں کی تعبیر کا علم بھی سکھلایا ہے اے آسمانو ں اور زمین کے بنانے والے! دنیا اور آخرت میں تو ہی میرا کارساز ہے تو مجھے اسلام پر موت دے اور مجھے نیک بختوں میں شامل کر دے

body.text_en: Indeed I have seen eleven stars and the sun and the moon prostrating to me.
Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan

body.arabic: ‏يَبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَفِرُونَ ‎
body.asad: [Hence,] O my sons, go forth and try to obtain some tidings of Joseph and his brother; and do not lose hope of God's life-giving mercy: [88] verily, none but people who deny the truth can ever lose hope of God's life-giving mercy.
body.phonetic: Ya baniyya ithhaboo fatahassasoo min yoosufa waakheehi wala tayasoo min rawhi Allahi innahu la yayasu min rawhi Allahi illa alqawmu alkafiroona
body.pickthall: "O my sons! Go you and enquire about Yusuf (Joseph) and his brother, and never give up hope of Allah's Mercy. Certainly no one despairs of Allah's Mercy, except the people who disbelieve."
body.text_en: "O my sons! Go you and enquire about Yusuf (Joseph) and his brother, and never give up hope of Allah's Mercy. Certainly no one despairs of Allah's Mercy, except the people who disbelieve."
body.urdu: اے میرے بیٹو! جاؤ یوسف اور اُس کے بھائی کی تلاش کرو اور اللہ کی رحمت سے نا امید نہ ہو بے شک اللہ کی رحمت سے نا امید نہیں ہوتے مگر وہی لوگ جو کافر ہیں

body.arabic: ‏وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ ‎
body.asad: And when everything will have been decided, Satan will say: "Behold, God promised you something that was bound to come true! [30] I, too, held out [all manner of] promises to you -but I deceived you. Yet I had no power at all over you: I but called you-and you responded unto me. Hence, blame not me, but blame yourselves. [31] It is not for me to respond to your cries, nor for you to respond to mine: [32] for, behold, I have [always] refused to admit that there was any truth in your erstwhile belief that I had a share in God's divinity." [33] Verily, for all evildoers [34] there is grievous suffering in store.
body.phonetic: Waqala alshshaytanu lamma qudiya alamru inna Allaha waAAadakum waAAda alhaqqi wawaAAadtukum faakhlaftukum wama kana liya AAalaykum min sultanin illa an daAAawtukum faistajabtum lee fala taloomoonee waloomoo anfusakum ma ana bimusrikhikum wama antum bimusrikhiyya innee kafartu bima ashraktumooni min qablu inna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun
body.pickthall: And Shaitan (Satan) will say when the matter has been decided: "Verily, Allah promised you a promise of truth. And I too promised you, but I betrayed you. I had no authority over you except that I called you, so you responded to me. So blame me not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can you help me. I deny your former act in associating me (Satan) as a partner with Allah (by obeying me in the life of the world). Verily, there is a painful torment for the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.)."
body.text_en: And Shaitan (Satan) will say when the matter has been decided: "Verily, Allah promised you a promise of truth. And I too promised you, but I betrayed you. I had no authority over you except that I called you, so you responded to me. So blame me not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can you help me. I deny your former act in associating me (Satan) as a partner with Allah (by obeying me in the life of the world). Verily, there is a painful torment for the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.)."
body.urdu:
اور جب فیصلہ ہو چکے گا تو شیطان کہے گا بےشک اللہ نے تم سے سچا وعدہ کیا تھا اورمیں نے بھی تم سے وعدہ کیا تھا پھر میں نے وعدہ خلافی کی اور میرا تم پر اس کے سوا کوئی زور نہ تھا کہ میں نے تمہیں بلایا پھر تم نے میری بات کو مان لیا پھر مجھے الزام نہ دو اور اپنے آپ کو الزام دونہ میں تمہارا فریادرس ہوں اور نہ تم میرے فریاد رس ہو میں خود تمہار
ے اس فعل سے بیزار ہوں کہ تم اس سےپہلے مجھے شریک بناتے تھے بے شک ظالموں کے لیے دردناک عذاب ہے

body.text_en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe

body.arabic: ‏فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَجِدِينَ ‎
body.asad: and when I have formed him fully and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down before him in prostration! [26]
body.phonetic: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
body.pickthall: "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves unto him."
body.text_en: "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves unto him."
body.urdu: پھر جب میں اسے ٹھیک بنالوں اور اس میں اپنی روح پھونک دوں تو تم اس کے آگے سجدہ میں گر پڑنا

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ ‎
body.asad: Said [Iblis]: "Then, O my Sustainer, grant me a respite till the Day when all shall be raised from the dead!"
body.phonetic: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
body.pickthall: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected."
body.text_en: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected."
body.urdu: کہا اے میرے رب! تو پھر مجھے قیامت کے دن تک مہلت دے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ ‎
body.asad: Answered He: "Verily, so be it: thou shalt be among those who are granted respite
body.phonetic: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
body.pickthall: Allah said: "Then, verily, you are of those reprieved,
body.text_en: Allah said: "Then, verily, you are of those reprieved,
body.urdu: فرمایا بےشک تجھے مہلت ہے

body.arabic: ‏إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ ‎
body.asad: till the Day the time whereof is known [to Me alone]."
body.phonetic: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
body.pickthall: "Till the Day of the time appointed."
body.text_en: "Till the Day of the time appointed."
body.urdu: وقت معلوم کے دن تک

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ‎
body.asad: [Whereupon Iblis] said: "O my Sustainer! Since Thou hast thwarted me, [29] I shall indeed make [all that is evil] on earth seem goodly to them, and shall most certainly beguile them-into grievous error -
body.phonetic: Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
body.pickthall: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Because you misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all.
body.text_en: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Because you misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all.
body.urdu: کہا اے میرے رب! جیسا تو نے مجھے گمراہ لیا ہے البتہ ضرور ضرور میں زمین میں انہیں ان کے گناہوں کو مرغوب کر کے دکھاؤں گا اور ان سب کو گمراہ کروں گا

body.arabic: ‏إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ ‎
body.asad: [all] save such of them as are truly Thy servants!" [30]
body.phonetic: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
body.pickthall: "Except Your chosen, (guided) slaves among them."
body.text_en: "Except Your chosen, (guided) slaves among them."
body.urdu: سوائے تیرے ان بندوں کے جو اُن میں مخلص ہو ں گے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ هَذَا صِرَطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ ‎
body.asad: Said He: "This is, with Me. a straight way: [31]
body.phonetic: Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun
body.pickthall: (Allah) said: "This is the Way which will lead straight to Me."
body.text_en: (Allah) said: "This is the Way which will lead straight to Me."
body.urdu: فرمایا یہ راستہ مجھ پر سیدھا ہے

body.arabic: ‏إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ ‎
body.asad: verily, thou shalt have no power over My creatures- unless it be such as are [already] lost in grievous error and follow thee [of their own will]: [32]
body.phonetic: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena
body.pickthall: "Certainly, you shall have no authority over My slaves, except those who follow you of the Ghawîn (Mushrikun and those who go astray, criminals, polytheists, and evil-doers, etc.).
body.text_en: "Certainly, you shall have no authority over My slaves, except those who follow you of the Ghawîn (Mushrikun and those who go astray, criminals, polytheists, and evil-doers, etc.).
body.urdu: بے شک میرے بندوں پر تیرا کچھ بھی بس نہیں چلے گا مگر جو گمراہوں میں سے تیرا تابعدار ہوا

body.arabic: ‏لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ ‎
body.asad: No weariness shall ever touch them in this [state of bliss], and never shall they have to forgo it. [35]
body.phonetic: La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena
body.pickthall: "No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave it."
body.text_en: "No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave it."
body.urdu: اُنہیں وہاں کوئی تکلیف نہیں پہنچے گی اور نہ وہ وہاں سے نکالے جائیں گے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ‎
body.asad: [Abraham] exclaimed: "And who-other than those who have utterly lost their way-could ever abandon the hope of his Sustainer's grace?"
body.phonetic: Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona
body.pickthall: [Ibrahim (Abraham)] said: "And who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except those who are astray?"
body.text_en: [Ibrahim (Abraham)] said: "And who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except those who are astray?"
body.urdu: کہا اپنے رب کی رحمت سے نا امید تو گمراہ لوگ ہی ہوا کرتے ہیں

body.arabic: ‏إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَفِظُونَ ‎
body.text_en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder, and indeed, We will be its guardian.
Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and beautiful preaching, and argue with them in ways that are best and most gracious
And Allah's is the loftiest similitude
So do not strike likenesses for Allah, for He knows and you do not
All that is with you is bound to come to an end, whereas all that which is with Allah is everlasting.
And We never punish until We have sent a messenger

variants.text_en: We do not punish until We have sent a messenger

body.arabic: ‏وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَدَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَقٍۢ ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْـًۭٔا كَبِيرًۭا ‎
body.asad: Hence, do not kill your children for fear of poverty : [36] it is We who shall provide sustenance for them as well as for you. Verily, killing them is a great sin.
body.phonetic: Wala taqtuloo awladakum khashyata imlaqin nahnu narzuquhum waiyyakum inna qatlahum kana khitan kabeeran
body.pickthall: And kill not your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Surely, the killing of them is a great sin.
body.text_en: And kill not your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Surely, the killing of them is a great sin.
body.urdu: اور اپنی اولاد کو تنگدستی کے ڈر سے قتل نہ کرو ہم انہیں بھی رزق دیتے ہیں اور تمہیں بھی بے شک ان کا قتل کرنا بڑا گناہ ہے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَىِٕنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ‎
body.asad: [And] he added: "Tell me, is this [foolish being] the one whom Thou hast exalted above me? Indeed, if Thou wilt but allow me a respite till the Day of Resurrection, I shall most certainly cause his descendants-all but a few-to obey me blindly ! [76]
body.phonetic: Qala araaytaka hatha allathee karramta AAalayya lain akhkhartani ila yawmi alqiyamati laahtanikanna thurriyyatahu illa qaleelan
body.pickthall: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "See? This one whom You have honoured above me, if You give me respite (keep me alive) to the Day of Resurrection, I will surely seize and mislead his offspring (by sending them astray) all but a few!"
body.text_en: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "See? This one whom You have honoured above me, if You give me respite (keep me alive) to the Day of Resurrection, I will surely seize and mislead his offspring (by sending them astray) all but a few!"
body.urdu: کہا بھلا دیکھ تو یہ شخص جسے تو نے مجھ سے بڑھایا اگرتو مجھے قیامت کے دن تک مہلت دے تو میں بھی سوائے چند لوگوں کے اس کی نسل کو قابو میں کر کے رہونگا

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ ٱذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ مَّوْفُورًۭا ‎
body.asad: [God] answered: "Go [the way thou hast chosen]! But as for such of them as shall follow thee - behold, hell will be the recompense of you (all], a recompense most ample!
body.phonetic: Qala ithhab faman tabiAAaka minhum fainna jahannama jazaokum jazaan mawfooran
body.pickthall: (Allah) said: "Go, and whosoever of them follows you, surely! Hell will be the recompense of you (all) an ample recompense.
body.text_en: (Allah) said: "Go, and whosoever of them follows you, surely! Hell will be the recompense of you (all) an ample recompense.
body.urdu: فرمایا جا۔ پھر ان میں سے جو کوئی تیرے ساتھ ہوا تو جہنم تم سب کی پوری سزا ہے

body.arabic: ‏وَٱسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَدِ وَعِدْهُمْ ۚ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا ‎
body.asad: Entice, then, with thy voice such of them as thou canst, and bear upon them with all thy horses and all thy men, [77] and be their partner in [all sins relating to] worldly goods and children, [78] and hold out [all manner of] promises to them: and [they will not know that] whatever Satan promises them is but meant to delude the mind. [79]
body.phonetic: Waistafziz mani istataAAta minhum bisawtika waajlib AAalayhim bikhaylika warajlika washarikhum fee alamwali waalawladi waAAidhum wama yaAAiduhumu alshshaytanu illa ghurooran
body.pickthall: "And Istafziz [literally means: befool them gradually] those whom you can among them with your voice (i.e. songs, music, and any other call for Allah's disobedience), make assaults on them with your cavalry and your infantry, mutually share with them wealth and children (by tempting them to earn money by illegal ways usury, etc., or by committing illegal sexual intercourse, etc.), and make promises to them." But Satan promises them nothing but deceit.
body.text_en: "And Istafziz [literally means: befool them gradually] those whom you can among them with your voice (i.e. songs, music, and any other call for Allah's disobedience), make assaults on them with your cavalry and your infantry, mutually share with them wealth and children (by tempting them to earn money by illegal ways usury, etc., or by committing illegal sexual intercourse, etc.), and make promises to them." But Satan promises them nothing but deceit.
body.urdu: اِن میں سے جسے تو اپنی آواز سنا کر بہکا سکتا ہے بہکا لے اور ان پر اپنے سوار اور پیادے بھی چڑھا دے اوران کے مال اور اولاد میں بھی شریک ہو جا اور ان سے وعدے کر اور شیطان کے وعدے بھی محض فریب ہی تو ہیں

body.arabic: ‏إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَنٌۭ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًۭا ‎
body.asad: "(And yet,] behold, thou shalt have no power over [such of] My servants [as place their trust in Me]: [80] for none is as worthy of trust as thy Sustainer."
body.phonetic: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun wakafa birabbika wakeelan
body.pickthall: "Verily! My slaves (i.e the true believers of Islamic Monotheism), you have no authority over them. And All-Sufficient is your Lord as a Guardian."
body.text_en: "Verily! My slaves (i.e the true believers of Islamic Monotheism), you have no authority over them. And All-Sufficient is your Lord as a Guardian."
body.urdu: بے شک میرے بندوں پر تیرا غلبہ نہیں ہو گا اور تیرا رب کافی کارساز ہے

body.text_en: They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord, and of knowledge ye have been vouchsafed but little.

body.arabic: ‏قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًۭا ‎
body.asad: Say: "None can bear witness between me and you as God does: verily, fully aware is He of His creatures, and He sees all [that is in their hearts]."
body.phonetic: Qul kafa biAllahi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum innahu kana biAAibadihi khabeeran baseeran
body.pickthall: Say: "Sufficient is Allah for a witness between me and you. Verily! He is the All-Knower, the All-Seer of His slaves."
body.text_en: Say: "Sufficient is Allah for a witness between me and you. Verily! He is the All-Knower, the All-Seer of His slaves."
body.urdu: کہہ دوکہ اللہ میرے اور تمہارے درمیان گواہ کافی ہے بے شک وہ اپنے بندوں سے خبردار دیکھنے والا ہے

body.arabic: ‏ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا ‎
body.text_en: summa-n-najji-l-ladhina-t-taqaw wa nadharu-z-zalimina fiha jithiyya (Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, kneeling).

body.arabic: ‏ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَلَمِينَ ‎
body.text_en: All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

body.arabic: ‏مَلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ‎
body.text_en: Master of the Day of Judgment.

body.arabic: ‏ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ ‎
body.text_en: Guide us to the straight path
Taha

body.arabic: ‏فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَنُ قَالَ يَٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍۢ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ ‎
body.asad: But Satan whispered unto him, saying: "O Adam! Shall I lead thee to the tree of life eternal; and [thus] to a kingdom that will never decay?" [106]
body.phonetic: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla
body.pickthall: Then Shaitan (Satan) whispered to him, saying : "O Adam! Shall I lead you to the Tree of Eternity and to a kingdom that will never waste away?"
body.text_en: Then Shaitan (Satan) whispered to him, saying : "O Adam! Shall I lead you to the Tree of Eternity and to a kingdom that will never waste away?"
body.urdu: پھر شیطان نے اس کے دل میں خیال ڈالا کہا اے آدم کیا میں تجھے ہمیشگی کا درخت بتاؤں اور ایسی بادشاہی جس میں ضعف نہ آئے

body.text_en: As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it

body.arabic: ‏إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَكِفُونَ ‎
body.text_en: What are these statues to which you are devoted?
And for every nation We have appointed a rite

body.arabic: ‏أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ ‎
body.asad: Did you, then, think that We created you in mere idle play, and that you would not have to return to Us?” [67]
body.phonetic: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona
body.pickthall: "Did you think that We had created you in play (without any purpose), and that you would not be brought back to Us?"
body.text_en: "Did you think that We had created you in play (without any purpose), and that you would not be brought back to Us?"
body.urdu: سو کیا تم یہ خیال کرتے ہو کہ ہم نے تمہیں نکما پیدا کیا ہے اور یہ کہ تم ہمارے پاس لوٹ کر نہیں آؤ گے

body.text_en: We created the human being from a quintessence of clay. Then We made him into a sperm-drop in a secure place. Then We made the drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump, and We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh; then We brought him forth as another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators

body.arabic: ‏فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ ‎
body.text_en: `Kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihun` (Each party rejoicing in that which is with them)
the Light of the heavens and the earth

body.arabic: ‏وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ ‎
body.text_en: wa-andhir 'ashirataka 'l-aqrabin (And warn your nearest kindred)
Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful'

And a man came running from the farthest end of the city. He said, 'Moses, the chiefs are taking counsel about you to slay you; so depart. Indeed, I am of those who counsel you well.' So he left the city, fearful and vigilant, saying, 'My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people'

body.arabic: ‏قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًۭا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَوَتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا۟ بِٱلْبَطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَسِرُونَ ‎
body.asad: Say [unto those who will not believe]: “God is witness enough between me and you! He knows all that is in the heavens and on earth; and they who are bent on believing in what is false and vain, and thus on denying God - it is they, they who shall be the losers!”
body.phonetic: Qul kafa biAllahi baynee wabaynakum shaheedan yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati waalardi waallatheena amanoo bialbatili wakafaroo biAllahi olaika humu alkhasiroona
body.pickthall: Say (to them O Muhammad PBUH): "Sufficient is Allah for a witness between me and you. He knows what is in the heavens and on earth." And those who believe in Batil (all false deities other than Allah), and disbelieve in Allah and (in His Oneness), it is they who are the losers.
body.text_en: Say (to them O Muhammad PBUH): "Sufficient is Allah for a witness between me and you. He knows what is in the heavens and on earth." And those who believe in Batil (all false deities other than Allah), and disbelieve in Allah and (in His Oneness), it is they who are the losers.
body.urdu: کہہ دو اللہ میرے اور تمہارے درمیان گواہ کافی ہے جو کچھ آسمانوں اور زمین میں ہے جانتا ہے اور جو لوگ جھوٹ پر ایمان لائے اوراللہ کا انکار کیا وہی نقصان پانے والے ہیں

body.arabic: ‏وَقَالُوا۟ لَن يَدْخُلَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَرَىٰ ۗ تِلْكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمْ ۗ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَدِقِينَ ‎
body.text_en: `haatu burhanakum in kuntum sadiqin` (Bring forth your proof, if you are truthful)

body.arabic: ‏ وَإِذِ ٱبْتَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَهِۦمَ رَبُّهُۥ بِكَلِمَتٍۢ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّى جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامًۭا ۖ قَالَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۖ قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهْدِى ٱلظَّلِمِينَ ‎
body.text_en: And We made him an Imam for mankind

body.arabic: ‏وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَهِیمُ ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ‎
body.text_en: when Ibrahim raised the foundations of the House. And Isma'il. 'Our Lord, accept from us.'

variants.text_en: And when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House, and Ishmael, 'Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.'

body.text_en: Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return
When it is said to them, follow what Allah has sent down, they say, rather we will follow what we have found our fathers following

body.arabic: ‏ تِلْكَ ٱلرُّسُلُ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۘ مِّنْهُم مَّن كَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَهُمْ دَرَجَتٍۢ ۚ وَآتَيْنَا عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْبَيِّنَتِ وَأَيَّدْنَهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ ۗ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا ٱقْتَتَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَتُ وَلَكِنِ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ آمَنَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن كَفَرَ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ وَلَكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ ‎
body.text_en: Those are the messengers; We preferred some of them over others.

body.arabic: ‏ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَوَتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَوَتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ‎
body.text_en: La ikraha fi al-din (There is no compulsion in religion).

variants.text_en: qad tabayyana al-rushdu min al-ghayy (the right course has become distinct from the wrong).

body.arabic: ‏وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًۭا تُرْجَعُونَ فِيهِ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ ‎
body.text_en: And fear a Day when you will be returned to Allah. Then every soul will be paid in full what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

body.arabic: ‏يَٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌۭ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ۚ ذَلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ ۖ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَرَةً حَاضِرَةًۭ تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌۭ وَلَا شَهِيدٌۭ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ ‎
body.text_en: O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down.

And when your Lord said to the angels, "I am going to place a caliph on the earth," they said, "Will You place in it one who corrupts it and sheds blood, while we glorify You with praise and sanctify You?" He said, "I know what you do not know."

body.arabic: ‏وَعَلَّمَ آدَمَ ٱلْأَسْمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِى بِأَسْمَآءِ هَٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَدِقِينَ ‎
body.asad: And He imparted unto Adam the names of all things; [23] then He brought them within the ken of the angels and said: "Declare unto Me the names of these [things], if what you say is true." [24]
body.phonetic: WaAAallama adama alasmaa kullaha thumma AAaradahum AAala almalaikati faqala anbioonee biasmai haolai in kuntum sadiqeena
body.pickthall: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."
body.text_en: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."
body.urdu: اور اللہ نے آدم کو سب چیزوں کے نام سکھائے پھر ان سب چیزوں کو فرشتوں کے سامنے پیش کیا پھر فرمایا مجھے ان کے نام بتاؤ اگر تم سچے ہو

body.arabic: ‏قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ‎
body.asad: They replied: "Limitless art Thou in Thy glory! No knowledge have we save that which Thou hast imparted unto us. Verily, Thou alone art all-knowing, truly wise."
body.phonetic: Qaloo subhanaka la AAilma lana illa ma AAallamtana innaka anta alAAaleemu alhakeemu
body.pickthall: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."
body.text_en: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."
body.urdu: انہوں نے کہا تو پاک ہے ہم تو اتنا ہی جانتے ہیں جتنا تو نے ہمیں بتایاہے بے شک تو بڑے علم والا حکمت والا ہے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ يَٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئْهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَوَتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ ‎
body.asad: Said He: "O Adam, convey unto them the names of these [things]." And as soon as [Adam] had conveyed unto them their names, [God] said: "Did I not say unto you, `Verily, I alone know the hidden reality of the heavens and the earth, and know all that you bring into the open and all. that you would conceal'?"
body.phonetic: Qala ya adamu anbihum biasmaihim falamma anbaahum biasmaihim qala alam aqul lakum innee aAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waaAAlamu ma tubdoona wama kuntum taktumoona
body.pickthall: He said: "O Adam! Inform them of their names," and when he had informed them of their names, He said: "Did I not tell you that I know the Ghaib (unseen) in the heavens and the earth, and I know what you reveal and what you have been concealing?"
body.text_en: He said: "O Adam! Inform them of their names," and when he had informed them of their names, He said: "Did I not tell you that I know the Ghaib (unseen) in the heavens and the earth, and I know what you reveal and what you have been concealing?"
body.urdu: فرمایا اے آدم ان چیزو ں کے نام بتا دو پھر جب آدم نے ا‘نہیں اُن کے نام بتا دیئے فرمایا کیا میں نے تمہیں نہیں کہا تھا کہ میں آسمانوں اور زمین کی چھپی ہوئی چیزیں جانتا ہوں اور جو تم ظاہر کرتے ہو اور جو چھپاتے ہو اسے بھی جانتا ہوں

body.arabic: ‏وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَفِرِينَ ‎
body.text_en: So prostrate... so they prostrated, except for Iblis. He refused and was arrogant and was among the disbelievers.

body.arabic: ‏وَقُلْنَا يَٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنْهَا رَغَدًا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّلِمِينَ ‎
body.asad: And We said: "O Adam, dwell thou and thy wife in this garden, [27] and eat freely thereof, both of you, whatever you may wish; but do not approach this one tree, lest you become wrongdoers." [28]
body.phonetic: Waqulna ya adamu oskun anta wazawjuka aljannata wakula minha raghadan haythu shituma wala taqraba hathihi alshshajarata fatakoona mina alththalimeena
body.pickthall: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
body.text_en: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
body.urdu: اور ہم نے کہا اے آدم تم اور تمہاری بیوی جنت میں جا کر رہو اور اس میں جو چاہو اور جہاں سےچاہو کھاؤ اور اس درخت کے نزدیک نہ جاؤ پھر ظالموں میں سے ہو جاؤ گے

body.arabic: ‏فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَنُ عَنْهَا فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِ ۖ وَقُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّۭ وَمَتَعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ ‎
body.text_en: `aduwwun ba`dukum li-ba`din `aduww` (You are enemies, one to another)

body.arabic: ‏فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ آدَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ‎
body.text_en: Then Adam received from his Lord [certain] words

variants.text_en: Indeed, it is He who is the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful

body.arabic: ‏قُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ ‎
body.text_en: Descend from it, all of you

body.arabic: ‏وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَتِنَآ أُو۟لَٓئِكَ أَصْحَبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَلِدُونَ ‎
body.asad: but those who are bent on denying the truth and giving the lie to Our messages - they are destined for the fire, and therein shall they abide.
body.phonetic: Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona
body.pickthall: But those who disbelieve and belie Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) such are the dwellers of the Fire, they shall abide therein forever.
body.text_en: But those who disbelieve and belie Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) such are the dwellers of the Fire, they shall abide therein forever.
body.urdu: اور جو انکار کریں گے اور ہماری آیتوں کو جھٹلائیں گے وہی دوزخی ہو ں گے جو اس میں ہمیشہ رہی گے

body.arabic: ‏وَإِذْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَبَ وَٱلْفُرْقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ ‎
body.asad: And [remember the time] when We vouchsafed unto Moses the divine writ-and [thus] a standard by which to discern the true from the false [38] -so that you might be guided aright;
body.phonetic: Waith atayna moosa alkitaba waalfurqana laAAallakum tahtadoona
body.pickthall: And (remember) when We gave Musa (Moses) the Scripture [the Taurat (Torah)] and the criterion (of right and wrong) so that you may be guided aright.
body.text_en: And (remember) when We gave Musa (Moses) the Scripture [the Taurat (Torah)] and the criterion (of right and wrong) so that you may be guided aright.
body.urdu: اورجب ہم نے موسیٰ کو کتاب اورقانون فیصل دیا تاکہ تم ہدایت پاؤ

body.arabic: ‏إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ‎
body.asad: BEHOLD, as for those who are bent on denying the truth [6] - it is all one to them whether thou warnest them or dost not warn them: they will not believe.
body.phonetic: Inna allatheena kafaroo sawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona
body.pickthall: Verily, those who disbelieve, it is the same to them whether you (O Muhammad Peace be upon him ) warn them or do not warn them, they will not believe.
body.text_en: Verily, those who disbelieve, it is the same to them whether you (O Muhammad Peace be upon him ) warn them or do not warn them, they will not believe.
body.urdu: بے شک جو لوگ انکار کر چکے ہیں برابر ہے انہیں تو ڈرائے یا نہ ڈرائے وہ ایمان نہیں لائیں گے

body.text_en: Whoever is grateful is grateful for the good of his own soul

body.arabic: ‏وَقَرْنَ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ ٱلْجَهِلِيَّةِ ٱلْأُولَىٰۖ وَأَقِمْنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَآتِينَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِعْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۚۥٓ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًۭا ‎
body.text_en: Indeed, Allah desires only to remove from you all impurity, O People of the Household, and to purify you with a thorough purification.

body.arabic: ‏مَّا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍۢ مِّن قَلْبَيْنِ فِى جَوْفِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَجَكُمُ ٱلَّٓـِٔى تُظَهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَتِكُمْ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَآءَكُمْ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ ۚ ذَلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُم بِأَفْوَهِكُمْ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِى ٱلسَّبِيلَ ‎
body.asad: NEVER has God endowed any man with two hearts in one body: [2] and [just as] He has never made your wives whom you may have declared to be “as unlawful to you as your mothers’ bodies” [truly] your mothers, [3] so, too, has He never made your adopted sons [truly] your sons: [4] these are but [figures of] speech uttered by your mouths - whereas God speaks the [absolute] truth: [5] and it is He alone who can show [you] the right path.
body.phonetic: Ma jaAAala Allahu lirajulin min qalbayni fee jawfihi wama jaAAala azwajakumu allaee tuthahiroona minhunna ommahatikum wama jaAAala adAAiyaakum abnaakum thalikum qawlukum biafwahikum waAllahu yaqoolu alhaqqa wahuwa yahdee alssabeela
body.pickthall: Allah has not put for any man two hearts inside his body. Neither has He made your wives whom you declare to be like your mothers' backs, your real mothers. [Az­Zihar is the saying of a husband to his wife, "You are to me like the back of my mother" i.e. You are unlawful for me to approach.], nor has He made your adopted sons your real sons. That is but your saying with your mouths. But Allah says the truth, and He guides to the (Right) Way.
body.text_en: Allah has not put for any man two hearts inside his body. Neither has He made your wives whom you declare to be like your mothers' backs, your real mothers. [Az­Zihar is the saying of a husband to his wife, "You are to me like the back of my mother" i.e. You are unlawful for me to approach.], nor has He made your adopted sons your real sons. That is but your saying with your mouths. But Allah says the truth, and He guides to the (Right) Way.
body.urdu: اللہ نے کسی شخص کے سینہ میں دو دل نہیں بنائے اور نہ اللہ نے تمہاری ان بیویوں کوجن سے تم ظہار کرتے ہو تمہاری ماں بنایا ہے اور نہ تمہارے منہ بولے بیٹوں کو تمہارا بیٹا بنایا ہے یہ تمہارے منہ کی بات ہے اور اللہ سچ فرماتا ہے اور وہی سیدھا راستہ بتاتا ہے

body.text_en: Our Lord, we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones, and they misled us from the way
Verily, Shaytan is your enemy, so treat him as your enemy.
Yasin

body.arabic: ‏وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ ‎
body.text_en: That is the decree of the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing
It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day; and each is swimming in an orbit.

body.arabic: ‏ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَبَنِىٓ آدَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ ‎
body.asad: Did I not enjoin on you, O you children of Adam, that you should not worship Satan – since, verily, he is your open foe [30]
body.phonetic: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
body.pickthall: Did I not ordain for you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitan (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.
body.text_en: Did I not ordain for you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitan (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.
body.urdu: اے آدم کی اولاد! کیا میں نے تمہیں تاکید نہ کر دی تھی کہ شیطان کی عبادت نہ کرنا کیونکہ وہ تمہارا صریح دشمن ہے

body.text_en: His command, when He intends a thing, is only to say to it 'Be,' and it is

body.arabic: ‏إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ ‎
body.asad: [For,] lo, [54] thy Sustainer said unto the angels: “Behold, I am about to create a human being out of clay; [55]
body.phonetic: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin
body.pickthall: (Remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "Truly, I am going to create man from clay".
body.text_en: (Remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "Truly, I am going to create man from clay".
body.urdu: جب تیرے رب نے فرشتوں سے کہا کہ میں ایک انسان مٹی سے بنانے والا ہوں

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ يَٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ ‎
body.asad: Said He: “O Iblis! What has kept thee from prostrating thyself before that [being] which I have created with My hands? [58] Art thou too proud [to bow down before another created being], or art thou of those who think [only] of themselves as high?” [59]
body.phonetic: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena
body.pickthall: (Allah) said: "O Iblîs (Satan)! What prevents you from prostrating yourself to one whom I have created with Both My Hands. Are you too proud (to fall prostrate to Adam) or are you one of the high exalted?"
body.text_en: (Allah) said: "O Iblîs (Satan)! What prevents you from prostrating yourself to one whom I have created with Both My Hands. Are you too proud (to fall prostrate to Adam) or are you one of the high exalted?"
body.urdu: فرمایا اے ابلیس! تمہیں اس کےے سجدہ کرنے سے کس نے منع کیا جسے میں نے اپنے ہاتھوں سے بنایا کیا تو نے تکبر کیا یا تو بڑوں میں سے تھا

body.text_en: O you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and die not except in a state of submission

body.arabic: ‏شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ‎
body.text_en: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him
that they would make it clear to the people and not conceal it

body.arabic: ‏ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًۭا مَّعْدُودَتٍۢ ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ ‎
body.text_en: That is because they said, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for a few numbered days," and they were deluded in their religion by what they used to invent.

body.arabic: ‏فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ ‎
body.text_en: So how will it be when We gather them for a Day about which there is no doubt, and every soul will be compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged?

body.arabic: ‏قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ ‎
body.text_en: Say, "O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent".

Let not the believers take disbelievers for their friends in preference to believers. Whoever does that has no connection with Allah unless you but guard yourselves against them, taking, as it were, security.

body.arabic: ‏إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّى مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَىَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَمَةِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ ‎
body.text_en: When Allah said, "O Isa, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection."

body.arabic: ‏هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَبَ مِنْهُ آيَتٌۭ مُّحْكَمَتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَبِهَتٌۭ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌۭ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱلرَّسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ ۗ يَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّۭ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَبِ ‎
body.text_en: and no one knows its interpretation except Allah and those well-grounded in knowledge

body.arabic: ‏مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُؤْتِيَهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكِتَبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُولَ لِلنَّاسِ كُونُوا۟ عِبَادًۭا لِّى مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَكِن كُونُوا۟ رَبَّنِيِّۦنَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلْكِتَبَ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَدْرُسُونَ ‎
body.text_en: It is not for a human [prophet] that Allah should give him the Scripture and authority and prophethood and then he would say to the people, 'Be servants to me rather than Allah.' Rather, [he would say], 'Be pious scholars of the Lord because of what you have taught of the Scripture and because of what you have studied.'

body.arabic: ‏رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ ‎
body.text_en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower

body.arabic: ‏وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ أَن تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٓئِكَةَ وَٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ أَرْبَابًا ۗ أَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ ‎
body.text_en: And he would not order you to take the angels and prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelief after you had submitted?

body.arabic: ‏وَإِذْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَقَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ لَمَآ آتَيْتُكُم مِّن كِتَبٍۢ وَحِكْمَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّصَدِّقٌۭ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِۦ وَلَتَنصُرُنَّهُۥ ۚ قَالَ ءَأَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَخَذْتُمْ عَلَىٰ ذَلِكُمْ إِصْرِى ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَقْرَرْنَا ۚ قَالَ فَٱشْهَدُوا۟ وَأَنَا۠ مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّهِدِينَ ‎
body.text_en: And [recall] when Allah took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him."

body.arabic: ‏فَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَسِقُونَ ‎
body.text_en: He said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses."

body.arabic: ‏أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ وَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلَمَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَوَتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًۭا وَكَرْهًۭا وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ ‎
body.text_en: And whoever turns away after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.

body.arabic: ‏رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ ‎
body.text_en: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise

body.arabic: ‏لَن تَنَالُوا۟ ٱلْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌۭ ‎
body.text_en: You will not attain righteousness until you spend from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it.

body.arabic: ‏ كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسْرَٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ ۗ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ فَٱتْلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَدِقِينَ ‎
body.text_en: All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful."

body.arabic: ‏فَمَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّلِمُونَ ‎
body.text_en: Then whoever invents falsehood about Allah after that - it is those who are the wrongdoers.
that the people of Joseph said, when he died, that Allah would never raise a messenger after him

body.arabic: ‏وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ ‎
body.text_en: Call upon Me; I will respond to you. Indeed, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Hell in humiliation.
Who is better in speech than one who calls to Allah, works righteousness, and says, 'I am of those who submit'?
And of His signs are the night, the day, the sun, and the moon.
We will show them Our Signs in the universe and in their own selves, until it becomes manifest to them that this is the truth
There is nothing whatsoever like Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing
He has prescribed for you of the religion that which He enjoined upon Noah
It is We who distribute their means of livelihood — their sustenance — among them in the life of this world.

body.arabic: ‏ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ ‎
body.asad: NOW WHENEVER [the nature of] the son of Mary is set forth as an example, [O Muhammad,] lo! thy people raise an outcry on this score,
body.phonetic: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona
body.pickthall: And when the son of Maryam (Mary) is quoted as an example [i.e. 'Iesa (Jesus) is worshipped like their idols), behold! Your people cry aloud (laugh out at the example).
body.text_en: And when the son of Maryam (Mary) is quoted as an example [i.e. 'Iesa (Jesus) is worshipped like their idols), behold! Your people cry aloud (laugh out at the example).
body.urdu: اورجب ابن مریم کی مثال بیان کی گئی تو اسی وقت آپ کی قوم کے لوگ اس سے کھلکھلا کر ہنسنے لگے

body.arabic: ‏وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ ‎
body.asad: and say, “Which is better - our deities or he?” [45] [But] it is only in the spirit of dispute that they put this comparison before thee: yea, they are conten­tious folk! [46]
body.phonetic: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona
body.pickthall: And say: "Are our aliha (gods) better or is he ['Iesa (Jesus)]?" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people. [(See VV. 21:97-101) - The Quran.]
body.text_en: And say: "Are our aliha (gods) better or is he ['Iesa (Jesus)]?" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people. [(See VV. 21:97-101) - The Quran.]
body.urdu: اورکہا کیا ہمارے معبود بہتر ہیں یا وہ یہ ذکر صرف آپ سے جھگڑنے کے لیے کرتے ہیں بلکہ وہ تو جھگڑالو ہی ہیں

body.arabic: ‏إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٓءِيلَ ‎
body.asad: [As for Jesus,] he was nothing but [a human being -] a servant [of Ours] whom We had graced [with prophethood], and whom We made an example for the children of Israel .
body.phonetic: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela
body.pickthall: He ['Iesa (Jesus)] was not more than a slave. We granted Our Favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel (i.e. his creation without a father).
body.text_en: He ['Iesa (Jesus)] was not more than a slave. We granted Our Favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel (i.e. his creation without a father).
body.urdu: وہ تو ہمارا ایک بندہ ہے جس پر ہم نے انعام کیا اور اسے بنی اسرائیل کے لیے نمونہ بنا دیا تھا

body.text_en: Verily, the noblest of you in the sight of Allah is the one who is most deeply conscious — most fearful — of Him.
if a transgressor brings them news they should investigate, lest they harm a people in ignorance and then become regretful

body.arabic: ‏وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمْ وَلَأُمَنِّيَنَّهُمْ وَلَآمُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ آذَانَ ٱلْأَنْعَمِ وَلَآمُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلْقَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّخِذِ ٱلشَّيْطَنَ وَلِيًّۭا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ خَسِرَ خُسْرَانًۭا مُّبِينًۭا ‎
body.asad: and shall lead them astray, and fill them with vain desires; and I shall command them - and they will cut off the ears of cattle [in idolatrous sacrifice]; and I shall command them - and they will corrupt God's creation!" [141] But all who take Satan rather than God for their master do indeed, most clearly, lose all:
body.phonetic: Walaodillannahum walaomanniyannahum walaamurannahum falayubattikunna athana alanAAami walaamurannahum falayughayyirunna khalqa Allahi waman yattakhithi alshshaytana waliyyan min dooni Allahi faqad khasira khusranan mubeenan
body.pickthall: Verily, I will mislead them, and surely, I will arouse in them false desires; and certainly, I will order them to slit the ears of cattle, and indeed I will order them to change the nature created by Allah." And whoever takes Shaitan (Satan) as a Walî (protector or helper) instead of Allah, has surely suffered a manifest loss.
body.text_en: Verily, I will mislead them, and surely, I will arouse in them false desires; and certainly, I will order them to slit the ears of cattle, and indeed I will order them to change the nature created by Allah." And whoever takes Shaitan (Satan) as a Walî (protector or helper) instead of Allah, has surely suffered a manifest loss.
body.urdu: اور البتہ انہیں ضرور گمراہ کروں گا اور البتہ ضرور انہیں امیدیں دلاؤں گا اور البتہ ضرور انہیں حکم کروں گا کہ جانوروں کے کان چیریں اور البتہ ضرور انہیں حکم دوں گاکہ اللہ کی بنائی ہوئی صورتیں بدلیں اور جو شخص اللہ کو چھوڑ کر شیطان کو دوست بنائے گا وہ صریح نقصان میں جا پڑا

body.arabic: ‏يَعِدُهُمْ وَيُمَنِّيهِمْ ۖ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا ‎
body.asad: he holds out promises to them, and fills them with vain desires: yet whatever Satan promises them is but meant to delude the mind. [142]
body.phonetic: YaAAiduhum wayumanneehim wama yaAAiduhumu alshshaytanu illa ghurooran
body.pickthall: He [Shaitan (Satan)] makes promises to them, and arouses in them false desires; and Shaitan's (Satan) promises are nothing but deceptions.
body.text_en: He [Shaitan (Satan)] makes promises to them, and arouses in them false desires; and Shaitan's (Satan) promises are nothing but deceptions.
body.urdu: شیطان ان سے وعدے کرتا ہےاور انہیں امیدیں دلاتا ہے اور شیطان ان سے صرف جھوٹے وعدے کرتا ہے

body.arabic: ‏وَقَوْلِهِمْ إِنَّا قَتَلْنَا ٱلْمَسِيحَ عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوهُ وَلَكِن شُبِّهَ لَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ مَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِلَّا ٱتِّبَاعَ ٱلظَّنِّ ۚ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ يَقِينًۢا ‎
body.text_en: They did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it was made to appear so to them.

variants.text_en: and they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but [another] was made to resemble him for them

body.text_en: mankind would have no argument against Allah after the messengers

body.arabic: ‏وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا لِيُطَاعَ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ إِذ ظَّلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ جَآءُوكَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ لَوَجَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا ‎
body.asad: for We have never sent any apostle save that he should be heeded by God's leave. [83] If, then, after having sinned against themselves, they would but come round to thee and ask God to forgive them - with the Apostle, too, praying that they be forgiven - they would assuredly find that God is an acceptor of repentance, a dispenser of grace.
body.phonetic: Wama arsalna min rasoolin illa liyutaAAa biithni Allahi walaw annahum ith thalamoo anfusahum jaooka faistaghfaroo Allaha waistaghfara lahumu alrrasoolu lawajadoo Allaha tawwaban raheeman
body.pickthall: And We did not send any messenger except to be obeyed by permission of Allah. And if, when they wronged themselves, they had come to you, [O Muhammad], and asked forgiveness of Allah and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
body.text_en: And We did not send any messenger except to be obeyed by permission of Allah. And if, when they wronged themselves, they had come to you, [O Muhammad], and asked forgiveness of Allah and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
body.urdu: اورہم نے کبھی کوئی رسول نہیں بھیجا مگر اسی واسطے کہ اللہ کے حکم سے اس کی تابعداری کی جائے اور جب انہوں نے اپنے نفسوں پر ظلم کیا تھا تیرے پاس آتے پھر اللہ سے معافی مانگتے اور رسول بھی اُن کی معافی کی درخواست کرتا تو یقیناًیہ اللہ کو بخشنے والا رحم کرنے والا پاتے

body.arabic:
‏وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ أَن يَقْتُلَ مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا خَطَـًۭٔا ۚ وَمَن قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا خَطَـًۭٔا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَةٍۢ وَدِيَةٌۭ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَصَّدَّقُوا۟ ۚ فَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوْمٍ عَدُوٍّۢ لَّكُمْ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَةٍۢ ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَقٌۭ فَدِيَةٌۭ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ وَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَةٍۢ ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْ�
�ِ تَوْبَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا ‎
body.asad: AND IT IS not conceivable that a believer should slay another believer, unless it be by mistake. [114] And upon him who has slain a believer by mistake there is the duty of freeing a believing soul from bondage and paying an indemnity to the victim's relations, [115] unless they forgo it by way of charity. Now if the slain, while himself a believer, belonged to a people who are at war with you, [116] [the penance shall be confined to] the freeing of a believing soul from bondage; whereas, if he belonged to a people to whom you are bound by a covenant, [it shall consist of] an indemnity to be paid to his relations in ad­dition to the freeing of a believing soul from bon­dage. [117] And he who does not have the wherewithal shall fast [instead] for two consecutive months. [118] (This is) the atonement ordained by God: and God is indeed all-knowing, wise.
body.phonetic: Wama kana limuminin an yaqtula muminan illa khataan waman qatala muminan khataan fatahreeru raqabatin muminatin wadiyatun musallamatun ila ahlihi illa an yassaddaqoo fain kana min qawmin AAaduwwin lakum wahuwa muminun fatahreeru raqabatin muminatin wain kana min qawmin baynakum wabaynahum meethaqun fadiyatun musallamatun ila ahlihi watahreeru raqabatin muminatin faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabiAAayni tawbatan mina Allahi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman
body.pickthall: It is not for a believer to kill a believer except (that it be) by mistake, and whosoever kills a believer by mistake, (it is ordained that) he must set free a believing slave and a compensation (blood money, i.e Diya) be given to the deceased's family, unless they remit it. If the deceased belonged to a people at war with you and he was a believer; the freeing of a believing slave (is prescribed), and if he belonged to a people with whom you have a treaty of mutual alliance, compensation (blood money - Diya) must be paid to his family, and a believing slave must be freed. And whoso finds this (the penance of freeing a slave) beyond his means, he must fast for two consecutive months in order to seek repentance from Allah. And Allah is Ever All­Knowing, All­Wise.
body.text_en: It is not for a believer to kill a believer except (that it be) by mistake, and whosoever kills a believer by mistake, (it is ordained that) he must set free a believing slave and a compensation (blood money, i.e Diya) be given to the deceased's family, unless they remit it. If the deceased belonged to a people at war with you and he was a believer; the freeing of a believing slave (is prescribed), and if he belonged to a people with whom you have a treaty of mutual alliance, compensation (blood money - Diya) must be paid to his family, and a believing slave must be freed. And whoso finds this (the penance of freeing a slave) beyond his means, he must fast for two consecutive months in order to seek repentance from Allah. And Allah is Ever All­Knowing, All­Wise.
body.urdu: اور مسلمانوں کا یہ کام نہیں کہ کسی مسلمان کو قتل کرے مگر غلطی سے اور جو مسلمان کو غلطی سے قتل کرے تو ایک مسلمان کی گردن آزاد کرے اور مقتول کے وارثوں کو خون بہا دے مگر یہ کہ وہ خون بہا معاف کر دیں پھر اگر وہ مسلمان مقتول کسی ایسی قوم میں تھا جس سے تمہاری دشمنی ہے تو ایک مومن غلام آزاد کرنا ہے اور اگر وہ مقتول مسلمان کسی ایسی قوم میں سے تھا جس سے تمہارا معاہدہ ہے تو اس کے وارثوں کو خون بہا دیا جائے گا اور ایک مومن غلام کو آزاد کرنا ہوگا پھر جو غلام نہ پائے وہ پے درپے دو مہینے کے روزے رکھے اللہ سےگناہ بخشوانے کے لیے اور اللہ جاننے والا حکمت والا ہے

body.arabic: ‏وَمَن يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًۭا مُّتَعَمِّدًۭا فَجَزَآؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ خَلِدًۭا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَعَنَهُۥ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُۥ عَذَابًا عَظِيمًۭا ‎
body.asad: But whoever deliberately slays another be­liever, his requital shall be hell, therein to abide; and God will condemn him, and will reject him, and will prepare for him awesome suffering.
body.phonetic: Waman yaqtul muminan mutaAAammidan fajazaohu jahannamu khalidan feeha waghadiba Allahu AAalayhi walaAAanahu waaAAadda lahu AAathaban AAatheeman
body.pickthall: And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell to abide therein, and the Wrath and the Curse of Allah are upon him, and a great punishment is prepared for him.
body.text_en: And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell to abide therein, and the Wrath and the Curse of Allah are upon him, and a great punishment is prepared for him.
body.urdu: اور جو کوئی کسی مسلمان کو جان کر قتل کرے اس کی سزا دوزخ ہے جس میں وہ ہمیشہ رہے گا اس پر اللہ کا غضب اور اس کی لعنت ہے اور اللہ نے اس کےلیے بڑا عذاب تیا رکیا ہے

body.arabic: ‏وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ ‎
body.text_en: Wa fi anfusikum afala tubsirun (And in your own selves. Will you not then see?)
And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember

body.arabic: ‏وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ ‎
body.text_en: laysa lil-insani illa ma sa'a
Indeed, We have created everything according to a measure

body.arabic: ‏يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَوَتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ ‎
body.text_en: Every day He is in [some] affair.

body.arabic: ‏وَٱلسَّبِقُونَ ٱلسَّبِقُونَ ‎
body.text_en: The forerunners, the forerunners, those are the ones brought near.

body.arabic: ‏لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ ‎
body.text_en: None touch it except the purified.
the First and the Last, and the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing

body.arabic: ‏ٱسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلشَّيْطَنُ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ ذِكْرَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٓئِكَ حِزْبُ ٱلشَّيْطَنِ ۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱلشَّيْطَنِ هُمُ ٱلْخَسِرُونَ ‎
body.asad: Satan has gained mastery over them, and has caused them to remain oblivious of the remem­brance of God. Such as these are Satan’s partisans: oh, verily, it is they, the partisans of Satan, who will truly be the losers!
body.phonetic: Istahwatha AAalayhimu alshshaytanu faansahum thikra Allahi olaika hizbu alshshaytani ala inna hizba alshshaytani humu alkhasiroona
body.pickthall: Shaitan (Satan) has overtaken them. So he has made them forget the remembrance of Allah. They are the party of Shaitan (Satan). Verily, it is the party of Shaitan (Satan) that will be the losers!
body.text_en: Shaitan (Satan) has overtaken them. So he has made them forget the remembrance of Allah. They are the party of Shaitan (Satan). Verily, it is the party of Shaitan (Satan) that will be the losers!
body.urdu: ان پر شیطان نے غلبہ پا لیا ہے پس اس نے انہیں اللہ کا ذکر بھلا دیا ہے یہی شیطان کا گروہ ہے خبردار بے شک شیطان کا گروہ ہی نقصان اٹھانے والا ہے

body.arabic: ‏لَّا تَجِدُ قَوْمًۭا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْآخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنْ حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَانُوٓا۟ آبَآءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَنَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ ۚ أُو۟لَٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْإِيمَنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۖ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَرُ خَلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ أُو۟لَٓئِكَ حِزْبُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ ‎
body.asad: Thou canst not find people who [truly] believe in God and the Last Day and [at the same time] love anyone who contends against God and His Apostle - even though they be their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or [others of] their kindred. [29] [As for the true believers,] it is they in whose hearts He has inscribed faith, and whom He has strength­ened with inspiration from Himself, [30] and whom [in time] He will admit into gardens through which running waters flow, therein to abide. Well-pleased is God with them, and well-pleased are they with Him. They are God’s partisans: oh, verily, it is they, the partisans of God, who shall attain to a happy state!
body.phonetic: La tajidu qawman yuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri yuwaddoona man hadda Allaha warasoolahu walaw kanoo abaahum aw abnaahum aw ikhwanahum aw AAasheeratahum olaika kataba fee quloobihimu aleemana waayyadahum biroohin minhu wayudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu olaika hizbu Allahi ala inna hizba Allahi humu almuflihoona
body.pickthall: You (O Muhammad PBUH) will not find any people who believe in Allah and the Last Day, making friendship with those who oppose Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad PBUH ), even though they were their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their kindred (people). For such He has written Faith in their hearts, and strengthened them with Ruh (proofs, light and true guidance) from Himself. And We will admit them to Gardens (Paradise) under which rivers flow, to dwell therein (forever). Allah is pleased with them, and they with Him. They are the Party of Allah. Verily, it is the Party of Allah that will be the successful.
body.text_en: You (O Muhammad PBUH) will not find any people who believe in Allah and the Last Day, making friendship with those who oppose Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad PBUH ), even though they were their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their kindred (people). For such He has written Faith in their hearts, and strengthened them with Ruh (proofs, light and true guidance) from Himself. And We will admit them to Gardens (Paradise) under which rivers flow, to dwell therein (forever). Allah is pleased with them, and they with Him. They are the Party of Allah. Verily, it is the Party of Allah that will be the successful.
body.urdu:
آپ ایسی کوئی قوم نہ پائیں گے جو اللہ 
اور قیامت کے دن پر ایمان رکھتی ہو اور ان لوگو ں سے بھی دوستی رکھتے ہوں جو اللہ اور اس کے رسول کی مخالفت کرتے ہیں گو وہ ان کے باپ یا بیٹے یا بھائی یا کنبے کے لوگ ہی کیوں نہ ہوں یہی وہ لوگ ہیں جن کے دلوں میں اللہ نے ایمان لکھ دیا ہے اور ان کو اپنے فیض سے قوت دی ہے اور وہ انہیں بہشتوں میں داخل کرے گا جن کے نیچے نہریں بہہ رہی ہوں گی وہ ان میں ہمیشہ رہیں گے اللہ ان سے راضی ہوا اور وہ اس سے راضی ہوئے یہی اللہ کا گروہ ہے خبردار بے شک اللہ کا گروہ ہی کامیاب ہونے والا ہے

body.arabic: ‏هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَدَةِ ۖ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ‎
body.asad: GOD IS HE save whom there is no deity: the One who knows all that is beyond the reach of a created being’s perception, as well as all that can be wit­nessed by a creature’s senses or mind: [27] He, the Most Gracious, the Dispenser of Grace.
body.phonetic: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati huwa alrrahmanu alrraheemu
body.pickthall: He is Allah, than Whom there is La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen (open). He is the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
body.text_en: He is Allah, than Whom there is La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen (open). He is the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
body.urdu: وہی اللہ ہے کہ اس کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں سب چھپی اور کھلی باتوں کا جاننے والا ہے وہ بڑا مہربان نہایت رحم والا ہے

body.arabic: ‏هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ‎
body.asad: God is He save whom there is no deity: the Sovereign Supreme, the Holy, the One with whom all salvation rests, [28] the Giver of Faith, the One who determines what is true and false, [29] the Almighty, the One who subdues wrong and restores right, [30] the One to whom all greatness belongs! Utterly remote is God, in His limitless glory, from anything to which men may ascribe a share in His divinity!
body.phonetic: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa almaliku alquddoosu alssalamu almuminu almuhayminu alAAazeezu aljabbaru almutakabbiru subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona
body.pickthall: He is Allah than Whom there is La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) the King, the Holy, the One Free from all defects, the Giver of security, the Watcher over His creatures, the All-Mighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glory be to Allah! (High is He) above all that they associate as partners with Him.
body.text_en: He is Allah than Whom there is La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) the King, the Holy, the One Free from all defects, the Giver of security, the Watcher over His creatures, the All-Mighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glory be to Allah! (High is He) above all that they associate as partners with Him.
body.urdu: وہی اللہ ہے کہ اس کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں وہ بادشاہ پاک ذات سلامتی دینے والا امن دینے والا نگہبان زبردست خرابی کا درست کرنے والا بڑی عظمت والا ہے اللہ پاک ہے اس سے جو اس کے شریک ٹھیراتے ہیں

body.arabic: ‏هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَوَتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ‎
body.asad: He is God, the Creator, the Maker who shapes all forms and appearances! [31] His [alone] are the attributes of perfection. [32] All that is in the heavens and on earth extols His limitless glory: for He alone is almighty, truly wise!
body.phonetic: Huwa Allahu alkhaliqu albario almusawwiru lahu alasmao alhusna yusabbihu lahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
body.pickthall: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor of all things, the Bestower of forms. To Him belong the Best Names . All that is in the heavens and the earth glorify Him. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
body.text_en: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor of all things, the Bestower of forms. To Him belong the Best Names . All that is in the heavens and the earth glorify Him. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
body.urdu: وہی اللہ ہے پیدا کرنے والا ٹھیک ٹھیک بنانے والا صورت دینے والا اس کے اچھے اچھے نام ہیں سب چیزیں اسی کی تسبیح کرتی ہیں جو آسمانوں میں اور زمین میں ہیں اور وہی زبردست حکمت والا ہے

body.text_en: O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger to make clear to you after a period of messengers
And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both offered a sacrifice [to Allah], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other.

body.arabic: ‏حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَٱلْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَٱلْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا۟ بِٱلْأَزْلَمِ ۚ ذَلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ ۚ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِى وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْإِسْلَمَ دِينًۭا ۚ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ فِى مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍۢ لِّإِثْمٍۢ ۙ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ ‎
body.text_en: al-yawma akmaltu lakum dinakum wa-atmamtu 'alaykum ni'mati (This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you)

body.arabic: ‏ يَٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلنَّصَرَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۘ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّلِمِينَ ‎
body.asad: O YOU who have attained to faith! Do not take the Jews and the Christians for your allies: they are but allies of one another [72] and whoever of you allies himself with them becomes, verily, one of them; behold, God does not guide such evildoers. [73]
body.phonetic: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo alyahooda waalnnasara awliyaa baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin waman yatawallahum minkum fainnahu minhum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena
body.pickthall: O you who believe! Take not the Jews and the Christians as Auliya' (friends, protectors, helpers, etc.), they are but Auliya' to one another. And if any amongst you takes them as Auliya', then surely he is one of them. Verily, Allah guides not those people who are the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong­doers and unjust).
body.text_en: O you who believe! Take not the Jews and the Christians as Auliya' (friends, protectors, helpers, etc.), they are but Auliya' to one another. And if any amongst you takes them as Auliya', then surely he is one of them. Verily, Allah guides not those people who are the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong­doers and unjust).
body.urdu: اے ایمان والو یہود اور نصاریٰ کو دوست نہ بناؤ وہ آپس میں ایک دوسرے کے دوست ہیں اور جو کوئی تم میں سے ان کے ساتھ دوستی کرے تو وہ انہیں سے ہے اللہ ظالموں کو ہدایت نہیں کرتا

body.text_en: did not forbid one another from wrongdoing they used to commit; evil indeed was the thing they did

body.arabic: ‏هُوَ ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّۦنَ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ ‎
body.text_en: He is the One who sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom, although they were before in clear error

variants.text_en: It is He who sent among the unlettered a Messenger

body.arabic: ‏يَٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نُودِىَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوْمِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فَٱسْعَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلْبَيْعَ ۚ ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ ‎
body.text_en: When the call is proclaimed for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah, then hasten to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade

body.arabic: ‏نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ ‎
body.text_en: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe

body.arabic: ‏وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّۭا شَيَطِينَ ٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلْجِنِّ يُوحِى بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ زُخْرُفَ ٱلْقَوْلِ غُرُورًۭا ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُ ۖ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ ‎
body.asad: AND THUS it is that against every prophet We have set up as enemies the evil forces from among humans as well as from among invisible beings that whisper unto one another glittering half-truths meant to delude the mind [98] But they could not do this unless thy Sustainer had so willed: stand, therefore, aloof from them and from all their false imagery!
body.phonetic: Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan shayateena alinsi waaljinni yoohee baAAduhum ila baAAdin zukhrufa alqawli ghurooran walaw shaa rabbuka ma faAAaloohu fatharhum wama yaftaroona
body.pickthall: And so We have appointed for every Prophet enemies - Shayatin (devils) among mankind and jinns, inspiring one another with adorned speech as a delusion (or by way of deception). If your Lord had so willed, they would not have done it, so leave them alone with their fabrications. (Tafseer Qurtubi, Vol.7, Page 67)
body.text_en: And so We have appointed for every Prophet enemies - Shayatin (devils) among mankind and jinns, inspiring one another with adorned speech as a delusion (or by way of deception). If your Lord had so willed, they would not have done it, so leave them alone with their fabrications. (Tafseer Qurtubi, Vol.7, Page 67)
body.urdu: اور اسی طرح ہم نے ہر نبی کے لیے شریر آدمیوں اور جنوں کو دشمن بنایا جو کہ ایک دوسرے کو طمع کرہوئی باتیں فریب دینے کے لیے سکھاتے ہیں اور اگر تیرا رب چاہتا تو یہ کام نہ کرتے سو تو انہیں اور جوجھوٹ بناتے ہیں اسے چھوڑ دے

body.text_en: Can he who was dead, to whom We gave life, and a light by which he can walk amongst men, be like him who is in the depths of darkness from which he can never come out?

body.arabic: ‏ئ قُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ أَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَبِٱلْوَلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَنًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَدَكُم مِّنْ إِمْلَقٍۢ ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْفَوَحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ ۖ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ ‎
body.asad: Say: "Come, let me convey unto you what God has [really] forbidden to you: "Do not ascribe divinity, in any way, to aught beside Him; and [do not offend against but, rather,] do good unto your parents; [146] and do not kill your children for fear of poverty - [for] it is We who shall provide sustenance for you as well as for them; [147] and do not commit any shameful deeds, be they open or secret; and do not take any human being's life-[the life] which God has declared to be sacred -otherwise than in [the pursuit of] justice: this has He enjoined upon you so that you might use your reason; [148]
body.phonetic: Qul taAAalaw atlu ma harrama rabbukum AAalaykum alla tushrikoo bihi shayan wabialwalidayni ihsanan wala taqtuloo awladakum min imlaqin nahnu narzuqukum waiyyahum wala taqraboo alfawahisha ma thahara minha wama batana wala taqtuloo alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi thalikum wassakum bihi laAAallakum taAAqiloona
body.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad PBUH): "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited you from: Join not anything in worship with Him; be good and dutiful to your parents; kill not your children because of poverty - We provide sustenance for you and for them; come not near to Al-Fawahish (shameful sins, illegal sexual intercourse, etc.) whether committed openly or secretly, and kill not anyone whom Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause (according to Islamic law). This He has commanded you that you may understand.
