body.text_en: Say (O Muhammad PBUH): "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited you from: Join not anything in worship with Him; be good and dutiful to your parents; kill not your children because of poverty - We provide sustenance for you and for them; come not near to Al-Fawahish (shameful sins, illegal sexual intercourse, etc.) whether committed openly or secretly, and kill not anyone whom Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause (according to Islamic law). This He has commanded you that you may understand.
body.urdu: کہہ دو آؤ میں تمہیں سنا دوں جو تمہارے رب نے تم پر حرام کیا ہے یہ کہ اس کے ساتھ کسی کو شریک نہ بناؤ اور ماں باپ کے ساتھ نیکی کرو اور تنگدستی کے سبب اپنی اولاد کو قتل نہ کرو ہم تمہیں اور انہیں رزق دیں گے اور بے حیائی کے ظاہر اور پوشیدہ کاموں کے قریب نہ جاؤ اور نا حق کسی جان کو قتل نہ کرو جس کا قتل اللہ نے حرام کیا ہے تمہیں یہ حکم دیتا ہے تاکہ تم سمجھ جاؤ

body.arabic: ‏ وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ آزَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا آلِهَةً ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ ‎
body.text_en: Azar raised him
But as for the one who has stood in awe of his Sustainer's Presence and restrained his inner self from base and evil desires, Paradise will be the place of rest.

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ ‎
body.asad: [And God] said: "What has kept thee from prostrating thyself when I commanded thee?" Answered [Iblis]: "I am better than he: Thou hast created me out of fire, whereas him Thou hast created out of clay."
body.phonetic: Qala ma manaAAaka alla tasjuda ith amartuka qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin
body.pickthall: (Allah) said: "What prevented you (O Iblîs) that you did not prostrate, when I commanded you?" Iblîs said: "I am better than him (Adam), You created me from fire, and him You created from clay."
body.text_en: (Allah) said: "What prevented you (O Iblîs) that you did not prostrate, when I commanded you?" Iblîs said: "I am better than him (Adam), You created me from fire, and him You created from clay."
body.urdu: فرمایاتجھے سجدہ کرنے سے کس چیز نے منع کیا ہے جب کہ میں نے تجھے حکم دیا کہا میں اس سے بہتر ہوں تو نے مجھے آگ سے بنایا اور اسے مٹی سے بنایا ہے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ فَٱهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ أَن تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا فَٱخْرُجْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّغِرِينَ ‎
body.asad: [God] said: "Down with thee, then, from this [state] -for it is not meet for thee to show arrogance here! Go forth, then: verily, among the humiliated shalt thou be!"
body.phonetic: Qala faihbit minha fama yakoonu laka an tatakabbara feeha faokhruj innaka mina alssaghireena
body.pickthall: (Allah) said: "(O Iblîs) get down from this (Paradise), it is not for you to be arrogant here. Get out, for you are of those humiliated and disgraced."
body.text_en: (Allah) said: "(O Iblîs) get down from this (Paradise), it is not for you to be arrogant here. Get out, for you are of those humiliated and disgraced."
body.urdu: کہاتو یہاں سے اتر جا تجھے یہ لائق نہیں کہ یہاں تکبر کرے پس نکل جا بے شک تو ذلیلوں میں سے ہے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ أَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ ‎
body.asad: Said [Iblis]: "Grant me a respite till the Day when all shall be raised from the dead."
body.phonetic: Qala anthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
body.pickthall: (Iblîs) said: "Allow me respite till the Day they are raised up (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)."
body.text_en: (Iblîs) said: "Allow me respite till the Day they are raised up (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)."
body.urdu: کہا مجھے اس دن تک مہلت دے جس دن لوگ قبرو ں سے اٹھائے جائیں گے

body.text_en: show me, that I may look upon You

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ ‎
body.asad: [And God] replied: "Verily, thou shalt be among those who are granted a respite."
body.phonetic: Qala innaka mina almunthareena
body.pickthall: (Allah) said: "You are of those allowed respite."
body.text_en: (Allah) said: "You are of those allowed respite."
body.urdu: فرمایا تجھے مہلت دی گئی ہے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ فَبِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَطَكَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ ‎
body.asad: [Whereupon Iblis] said: "Now that Thou hast thwarted me," [11] shall most certainly lie in ambush for them all along Thy straight way,
body.phonetic: Qala fabima aghwaytanee laaqAAudanna lahum sirataka almustaqeema
body.pickthall: (Iblîs) said: "Because You have sent me astray, surely I will sit in wait against them (human beings) on Your Straight Path.
body.text_en: (Iblîs) said: "Because You have sent me astray, surely I will sit in wait against them (human beings) on Your Straight Path.
body.urdu: کہا جیسا تو نے مجھے گمراہ کیا ہے میں بھی ضرور ان کی تاک میں تیری سیدھی راہ پر بیٹھوں گا

body.arabic: ‏ثُمَّ لَآتِيَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَنِهِمْ وَعَن شَمَآئِلِهِمْ ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَكِرِينَ ‎
body.asad: and shall most certainly fall upon them openly as well as in a manner beyond their ken, [12] and from their right and from their left: and most of them Thou wilt find ungrateful."
body.phonetic: Thumma laatiyannahum min bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim waAAan aymanihim waAAan shamailihim wala tajidu aktharahum shakireena
body.pickthall: Then I will come to them from before them and behind them, from their right and from their left, and You will not find most of them as thankful ones (i.e. they will not be dutiful to You)."
body.text_en: Then I will come to them from before them and behind them, from their right and from their left, and You will not find most of them as thankful ones (i.e. they will not be dutiful to You)."
body.urdu: پھر ان کے پاس ان کے آگے ان کے پیچھے ان کے دائیں اور ان کے بائیں سےآؤں گا اور تو اکثر کو ان میں سے شکر گزار نہیں پائے گا

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ ٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًۭا ۖ لَّمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ‎
body.asad: [And God] said: "Go forth from here, disgraced and disowned! [And] as for such of them as follow thee - I will most certainly fill hell with you all!
body.phonetic: Qala okhruj minha mathooman madhooran laman tabiAAaka minhum laamlaanna jahannama minkum ajmaAAeena
body.pickthall: (Allah) said (to Iblîs) "Get out from this (Paradise) disgraced and expelled. Whoever of them (mankind) will follow you, then surely I will fill Hell with you all."
body.text_en: (Allah) said (to Iblîs) "Get out from this (Paradise) disgraced and expelled. Whoever of them (mankind) will follow you, then surely I will fill Hell with you all."
body.urdu: فرمایا یہاں سے ذلیل و خوار ہو کر نکل جا جو شخص ان سے تیرا کہا مانے گا میں تم سب کو جہنم میں بھر دوں گا

body.arabic: ‏وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَٱدْعُوهُ بِهَا ۖ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ أَسْمَٓئِهِۦ ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ‎
body.asad: AND GOD'S [alone] are the attributes of perfection; [145] invoke Him, then, by these, and stand aloof from all who distort the meaning of His attributes: [146] they shall be requited for all that they were wont to do!
body.phonetic: Walillahi alasmao alhusna faodAAoohu biha watharoo allatheena yulhidoona fee asmaihi sayujzawna ma kanoo yaAAmaloona
body.pickthall: And (all) the Most Beautiful Names belong to Allah, so call on Him by them, and leave the company of those who belie or deny (or utter impious speech against) His Names. They will be requited for what they used to do.
body.text_en: And (all) the Most Beautiful Names belong to Allah, so call on Him by them, and leave the company of those who belie or deny (or utter impious speech against) His Names. They will be requited for what they used to do.
body.urdu: اور سب اچھے نام اللہ ہی کے لیے ہیں سو اسے انہیں نامو ں سے پکارو اور چھوڑ دو ان کو جو اللہ کے نامو ں میں کجروی اختیار کرتے ہیں وہ اپنے کیے کی سزا پا کر رہیں گے

body.arabic: ‏إِنَّ وَلِۦِّىَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْكِتَبَ ۖ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى ٱلصَّلِحِينَ ‎
body.asad: Verily, my protector is God, who has bestowed this divine writ from on high: for it is He who protects the righteous,
body.phonetic: Inna waliyyiya Allahu allathee nazzala alkitaba wahuwa yatawalla alssaliheena
body.pickthall: "Verily, my Walî (Protector, Supporter, and Helper, etc.) is Allah Who has revealed the Book (the Quran), and He protects (supports and helps) the righteous.
body.text_en: "Verily, my Walî (Protector, Supporter, and Helper, etc.) is Allah Who has revealed the Book (the Quran), and He protects (supports and helps) the righteous.
body.urdu: بےشک میرا حمایتی اللہ ہے جس نے کتاب نازل فرمائی اور وہ نیکو کاروں کی حمایت کرتا ہے

body.arabic: ‏فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَنُ لِيُبْدِىَ لَهُمَا مَا وُۥرِىَ عَنْهُمَا مِن سَوْءَتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهَىٰكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هَذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَا مَلَكَيْنِ أَوْ تَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْخَلِدِينَ ‎
body.asad: Thereupon Satan whispered unto the two with a view to making them conscious of their nakedness, of which [hitherto] they had been unaware; [14] and he said: "Your Sustainer has but forbidden you this tree lest you two become .[as] angels, or lest you live forever." [15]
body.phonetic: Fawaswasa lahuma alshshaytanu liyubdiya lahuma ma wooriya AAanhuma min sawatihima waqala ma nahakuma rabbukuma AAan hathihi alshshajarati illa an takoona malakayni aw takoona mina alkhalideena
body.pickthall: Then Shaitan (Satan) whispered suggestions to them both in order to uncover that which was hidden from them of their private parts (before); he said: "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree save you should become angels or become of the immortals."
body.text_en: Then Shaitan (Satan) whispered suggestions to them both in order to uncover that which was hidden from them of their private parts (before); he said: "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree save you should become angels or become of the immortals."
body.urdu: پھرانہیں شیطان نے بہکایا تاکہان کی شرم گاہیں جو ایک دوسرے سے چھپائی گئی تھیں ان کے سامنے کھول دے اور کہا تمہیں تمہارے رب نے اس درخت سے نہیں روکا مگر اس لیے کہ کہیں تم فرشتے ہو جاؤ یا ہمیشہ رہنے والے ہو جاؤ

body.arabic: ‏وَقَاسَمَهُمَآ إِنِّى لَكُمَا لَمِنَ ٱلنَّصِحِينَ ‎
body.asad: And he swore unto them, "Verily, I am of those who wish you well indeed!"
body.phonetic: Waqasamahuma innee lakuma lamina alnnasiheena
body.pickthall: And he [Shaitan (Satan)] swore by Allah to them both (saying): "Verily, I am one of the sincere well­wishers for you both."
body.text_en: And he [Shaitan (Satan)] swore by Allah to them both (saying): "Verily, I am one of the sincere well­wishers for you both."
body.urdu: اور ان کے روبرو قسم کھائی کہ البتہ میں تمہارا خیرا خواہ ہوں

body.arabic: ‏فَدَلَّىٰهُمَا بِغُرُورٍۢ ۚ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا ٱلشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَنَادَىٰهُمَا رَبُّهُمَآ أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَن تِلْكُمَا ٱلشَّجَرَةِ وَأَقُل لَّكُمَآ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَنَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ ‎
body.asad: -and thus he led them on with deluding thoughts. But as soon as the two had tasted [the fruit] of the tree, they became conscious of their nakedness; and they began to cover themselves with pieced-together leaves from the garden. And their Sustainer called unto them: "Did I not forbid that tree unto you and tell you, `Verily, Satan is your open foe'?"
body.phonetic: Fadallahuma bighuroorin falamma thaqa alshshajarata badat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati wanadahuma rabbuhuma alam anhakuma AAan tilkuma alshshajarati waaqul lakuma inna alshshaytana lakuma AAaduwwun mubeenun
body.pickthall: So he misled them with deception. Then when they tasted of the tree, that which was hidden from them of their shame (private parts) became manifest to them and they began to stick together the leaves of Paradise over themselves (in order to cover their shame). And their Lord called out to them (saying): "Did I not forbid you that tree and tell you: Verily, Shaitan (Satan) is an open enemy unto you?"
body.text_en: So he misled them with deception. Then when they tasted of the tree, that which was hidden from them of their shame (private parts) became manifest to them and they began to stick together the leaves of Paradise over themselves (in order to cover their shame). And their Lord called out to them (saying): "Did I not forbid you that tree and tell you: Verily, Shaitan (Satan) is an open enemy unto you?"
body.urdu: پھر انہیں دھوکہ سے مائل کر لیا پھرجب ان دونوں نے درخت کو چکھا تو ان پر ان کی شرم گاہیں کھل گئیں اور اپنے اوپر بہشت کے پتے جوڑنے لگے اورانہیں ان کے رب نے پکارا کیا میں نے تمہیں اس درخت سے منع نہیں کیا تھا اور تمہیں کہ نہ دیا تھا کہ شیطان تمہارا کھلا دشمن ہے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَسِرِينَ ‎
body.asad: The two replied: "O our Sustainer! We have sinned against ourselves -and unless Thou grant us forgiveness and bestow Thy mercy upon us, we shall most certainly be lost!"
body.phonetic: Qala rabbana thalamna anfusana wain lam taghfir lana watarhamna lanakoonanna mina alkhasireena
body.pickthall: They said: "Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If You forgive us not, and bestow not upon us Your Mercy, we shall certainly be of the losers."
body.text_en: They said: "Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If You forgive us not, and bestow not upon us Your Mercy, we shall certainly be of the losers."
body.urdu: ان دونوں نے کہا اے رب ہمارے ہم نے اپنی جانوں پر ظلم کیا اور اگر تو ہمیں نہ بخشے گا اور ہم پر رحم نہ کرے گا تو ہم ضرور تباہ ہوجائیں گے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّۭ وَمَتَعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ ‎
body.asad: Said He: "Down with you, [16] [and be henceforth] enemies unto one another, having on earth your abode and livelihood for a while:
body.phonetic: Qala ihbitoo baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun walakum fee alardi mustaqarrun wamataAAun ila heenin
body.pickthall: (Allah) said: "Get down, one of you an enemy to the other [i.e. Adam, Hawwa (Eve), and Shaitan (Satan), etc.]. On earth will be a dwelling­place for you and an enjoyment, - for a time."
body.text_en: (Allah) said: "Get down, one of you an enemy to the other [i.e. Adam, Hawwa (Eve), and Shaitan (Satan), etc.]. On earth will be a dwelling­place for you and an enjoyment, - for a time."
body.urdu: فرمایا یہاں سے اترو تم ایک دوسرے کے دشمن ہو گے اور تمہارے لیے زمین میں ٹھکانا ہے اور ایک وقت تک نفع اٹھانا ہے

body.arabic: ‏قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ ‎
body.asad: there shall you live" - He added - "and there shall you die, and thence shall you be brought forth [on Resurrection Day]!
body.phonetic: Qala feeha tahyawna wafeeha tamootoona waminha tukhrajoona
body.pickthall: He said: "Therein you shall live, and therein you shall die, and from it you shall be brought out (i.e.resurrected)."
body.text_en: He said: "Therein you shall live, and therein you shall die, and from it you shall be brought out (i.e.resurrected)."
body.urdu: فرمایا تم اسی میں زندہ رہو گے اور اسی میں مرو گے اور اسی سے نکالے جاؤ گے

body.text_en: O reassured soul, return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing (verses 27 through 30)

body.arabic: ‏وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا ‎
body.asad: and truly lost is he who buries it [in darkness].
body.phonetic: Waqad khaba man dassaha
body.pickthall: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, He has succeeded who purifies himself, And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
body.text_en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, He has succeeded who purifies himself, And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
body.urdu: اوربے شک وہ غارت ہوا جس نے اس کو آلودہ کر لیا

body.text_en: And by the soul and Him who proportioned it, who inspired it with discernment of its corruption and its righteousness: successful is the one who purifies it, and lost is the one who corrupts it.

body.arabic: ‏فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا ‎
body.asad: and how it is imbued with moral failings as well as with consciousness of God! [6]
body.phonetic: Faalhamaha fujooraha wataqwaha
body.pickthall: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, He has succeeded who purifies himself, And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
body.text_en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, He has succeeded who purifies himself, And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
body.urdu: پھر اس کو اس کی بدی اور نیکی سمجھائی

body.arabic: ‏قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا ‎
body.asad: To a happy state shall indeed attain he who causes this [self] to grow in purity,
body.phonetic: Qad aflaha man zakkaha
body.pickthall: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, He has succeeded who purifies himself, And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
body.text_en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, He has succeeded who purifies himself, And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
body.urdu: بے شک وہ کامیاب ہوا جس نے اپنی روح کو پاک کر لیا

body.text_en: Take from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke the blessing of Allah upon them

body.arabic: ‏ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَنَهُمْ أَرْبَابًۭا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسِيحَ ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَهًۭا وَحِدًۭا ۖ لَّآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ سُبْحَنَهُۥ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ‎
body.asad: They have taken their rabbis and their monks-as well as the Christ, son of Mary-for their lords beside God, [47] although they had been bidden to worship none but the One God, save whom there is no deity: the One who is utterly remote, in His limitless glory, from anything to which they may ascribe a share in His divinity!
body.phonetic: Ittakhathoo ahbarahum waruhbanahum arbaban min dooni Allahi waalmaseeha ibna maryama wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo ilahan wahidan la ilaha illa huwa subhanahu AAamma yushrikoona
body.pickthall: They (Jews and Christians) took their rabbis and their monks to be their lords besides Allah (by obeying them in things which they made lawful or unlawful according to their own desires without being ordered by Allah), and (they also took as their Lord) Messiah, son of Maryam (Mary), while they (Jews and Christians) were commanded [in the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)) to worship none but One Ilah (God - Allah) La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). Praise and glory be to Him, (far above is He) from having the partners they associate (with Him)."
body.text_en: They (Jews and Christians) took their rabbis and their monks to be their lords besides Allah (by obeying them in things which they made lawful or unlawful according to their own desires without being ordered by Allah), and (they also took as their Lord) Messiah, son of Maryam (Mary), while they (Jews and Christians) were commanded [in the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)) to worship none but One Ilah (God - Allah) La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). Praise and glory be to Him, (far above is He) from having the partners they associate (with Him)."
body.urdu: انہوں نے اپنے عالموں اور درویشوں کو اللہ کے سوا خدا بنا لیا ہے اور مسیح مریم کے بیٹےکو بھی حالانکہ انہیں حکم یہی ہوا تھا کہ ایک اللہ کے سوا کسی کی عبادت نہ کریں اس کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں وہ ان لوگوں کے شریک مقرر کرنے سے پاک ہے
